decisions.reason: It fits the core laser-marking business and remains on the website, but as a 2023 product with only modest website prominence and some overlap with newer laser offerings, it has a somewhat higher chance of being rationalized than the others.

This close-to-core thermal inkjet printer still has its own page in 2024, so with no negative signal and low uncertainty resolved so far, the option value of keeping it remains higher than the likely carrying cost.
The piezo inkjet printer is also a close extension of the established range and still actively presented on its own page, so management would likely keep it while market learning continues.

As a very recent 2024 launch shown on the home page and directly aligned with the firm's strategic push in industrial identification, it is too early and too relevant to drop absent clear failure evidence.
The new compact laser marking cabin has its own launch page and builds on established laser capabilities, making it a low-cost strategic option that a growing large firm would normally retain.

Although niche, this lubricant printing system won a trade-fair award and extends the firm's high-resolution coding competence into sheet metal applications, which strongly supports keeping it on the market.
